scope: Null Weight analysis elimination; originals remain unchanged; no ISAE acceptance claim.
finding: Exact-zero physical fields define a mathematically null point object. Eliminating its physical attachment, flow queries and inertial contribution is supported by the equations, without inferring legacy executable behavior.

predicate.rule: Finite shape-(17,) scaled row and every row[5:17] exactly zero; no tolerance and no decision from Weight alone.
predicate.geometry: t and Xo/Yo/Zo define a massless rigid pylon, not independent stiffness or degrees of freedom. They cannot create a load when every physical coefficient vanishes.
predicate.preservation: Original row objects, .source and lossless dumps remain intact. Analysis lists preserve row identity and order among active objects; raw arrays passed with active point data are rejected by length guards.
predicate.parameter_edits: The selector is recomputed from current rows, so changing a physical field before constructing a new analysis activates the object and restores ordinary anchor checks.

mathematical_basis: Manual aswing_doc.txt439–453: point object on massless rigid pylon; omitted fields default to zero.174–196 defines scaling then addition.

Steady Eq95–96, asw_theory.txt957–959: mass*(g-a)+drag; arm cross force, spin gyroscopic torque, tensor angular-acceleration and gyroscopic torque. All vanish for zero mass,CDA,H,I regardless of finite pose/motion.
Steady Eq164,1720–1729: point source and doublet strengths are CDA and Vol; Vol must also be zero to eliminate aerodynamic feedback.

Unsteady Eq46–47, asw_uns_theory.txt460–478: same nullity under beam rates/accelerations. Engine force/moment terms belong to separately declared Engine objects, which remain active and separately anchored (manual602–616).

State, time, circulation, flap and engine-control derivatives of these fixed-zero contributions are zero. Derivatives with respect to the physical Weight coefficients themselves need not be zero; no such design-parameter derivative is discarded. Current operating controls update FlightCondition control/power maps, not Weight records.

implementation.shared_view: openswing/point_objects.py: active_weight_items and active_weights; null_weight exact predicate.
implementation.indices: Internal point arrays use contiguous active ordering. Original record numbers remain in mesh requirement labels and signed-weight diagnostics; InertiaModel.source_point_indices maps internal indices to original rows.
implementation.unused_raw_reads: asw_edit serialization/provenance and parser beam-reference validation intentionally retain raw records. Aero/quiescent validation still checks all declared physical fields; null rows trivially pass these checks.

original_scope.AE1: Two null .558 records beyond .55. Original sensors are valid at .55. Literal mesh/network construction and residual evaluation now pass.
original_scope.ST2_modal: Both original modal models have two entirely null rows. SourceDynamicNetwork setup passes; no modal or gravity-equilibrium acceptance asserted.
original_scope.ST2_static: All four static cached model copies carry nonzero weights and remain blocked by .558 beyond .55. No correction, extrapolation or clamp.

qualifications: The documentation does not explicitly promise that legacy ASWING accepts invalid null anchors; this is an equation-based current analysis simplification.
No native ASWING executable was used. Historical mesh/settings and AE1/ST2 archived-output parity remain separate validation tasks.
Null objects no longer insert arbitrary interior mesh nodes. Explicit requested load/station, sensor, engine, strut, joint and ground requirements remain effective.
Existing saved equilibria still undergo their normal identity/node checks; no saved result is relabelled as a new pass.
All applicable existing nonnegative/PSD/undefined-beam checks remain. Tiny signed nonzero physical fields are never treated as zero.
